decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1.	The conversion of the property into two flats results in the loss of single family accommodation, out of character with the area and resulting in a loss of family accommodation, contrary to policy H 1.5 of the Unitary Development Plan and policy H 3.4 of the Revised Deposit Version Unitary Development Plan 
2.	No off street parking is proposed, which would lead to conditions prejudicial to highway and pedestrian safety, contrary to policies H 1.5 and T 2.5 of the Unitary Development Plan and policies H 3.4 and T 1.4 of the Revised Deposit Version Unitary Development Plan 
3.	The creation of the two flats would result in noise and disturbance to adjoining and nearby residents through increased activity, detrimental to residential amenity and the character of the area,  contrary to Unitary Development Plan  policies ENV.1.1 and H.1.5 and Revised Deposit Version Unitary Development Plan  policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.3.4.
description: Conversion of existing dwellinghouse into 2 x 2 bedroom self contained flats
